# The Stallion Metallist

> International non-ferrous metal-scrap trading company. Canada-incorporated (Calgary,
> AB) and operating on the ground in Dehradun, India. We source non-ferrous scrap across
> UAE, China, Europe and North America and deliver to India's furnaces, foundries and
> mills. We also run a doorstep collection service in Dehradun for used aluminium cans
> (UBC) and PET bottles, for homes and for bars, restaurants and cafes.

## Collection in Dehradun
- Aluminium cans (UBC): ₹1.5 per can, counted on the spot, paid on collection. https://www.thestallionmetallist.com/aluminium-can-collection-dehradun
- PET bottles: ₹18 per kg, weighed at your door, for homes and businesses. Book on WhatsApp. https://www.thestallionmetallist.com/pet-bottle-collection-dehradun
- Bars, restaurants and cafes: free collection bins (as stock allows), scheduled pickups, paid on the spot at every pickup. Standard rates ₹1.5 per can and ₹18 per kg of PET. https://www.thestallionmetallist.com/bar-restaurant-can-bottle-collection-dehradun
- We currently collect aluminium cans and PET bottles. Rates last updated 26 October 2026.

## What we trade
- Aluminium: UBC (baled), Zorba, Twitch
- Copper: Millberry, Bare Bright
- Brass: Honey
- Stainless Steel: 304 / 316

## How we operate
Source → Negotiate → Clear (Mundra, Kandla, JNPT) → Deliver (Gujarat belt) → Settle (LC at sight / T/T)

## Scale
4 sourcing markets · 3 major Indian ports · 100+ vetted partners
